label: Глядеть
description: A 10-sentence conjugation card for глядеть (to look, to gaze).

missions.phrase: Я гляжу в окно на снег.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: First-person singular present. Глядеть is imperfective. Note the 1sg mutation д → ж in 'гляжу', against глядишь elsewhere. 'В окно' shows direction of gaze.
Strategic focus: Second-person singular present. 'Глядишь' keeps the unmutated стем гляд- with the -ишь ending. 'На меня' marks the target of the look.

missions.phrase: Кот глядит на птицу за окном.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Third-person singular present. 'Глядит' takes the -ит ending. The sentence shows a fixed, attentive gaze, the core sense of глядеть.

missions.phrase: Мы глядим на звёзды всю ночь.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: First-person plural present. 'Глядим' uses the -им ending. 'На звёзды' marks the object of a long, shared gaze.
Strategic focus: Third-person plural present. 'Глядят' closes the present set with the -ят ending. 'Вдаль' gives the direction of the distant gaze.

missions.phrase: Он долго глядел на старое фото.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Past, masculine. 'Глядел' is the masculine -л past of глядеть. 'Долго' stresses the durative, imperfective looking.
Strategic focus: Past, feminine. 'Глядела' adds the feminine -ла ending. The verb conveys a quiet, sustained gaze at the sea.
Strategic focus: Past, plural. 'Глядели' is the plural -ли past, shared by all genders. It reports a shared, attentive watching.
Strategic focus: Imperative, singular. 'Гляди' is the informal command of глядеть. The contrast 'вперёд, а не назад' gives a vivid metaphorical order.
Strategic focus: Infinitive use. 'Глядеть' stays in the dictionary form after evaluative 'приятно'. The imperfective infinitive fits an open-ended, pleasant act of looking.
